effects.prose: The expedition is overrun; crew must extract this round or lose.

objective-complete.prose: The Ancient Relay has been activated and at least one crew member has extracted.

spider-can-feed.prose: A spider is eligible to consume a Spider Corpse at its location.

spider-can-pupate.prose: A qualifying fed spider has consumed enough corpses and escaped danger.

overrun-deadline-expired.prose: Threat has reached 12 and no crew extracted before the end of the current round.

security-training-next-attack.prose: Apply the Security Training modifier to this actor's next Attack this turn.

apply-weapon-noise.prose: After a noisy attack, add the weapon's Noise value to scenario Threat. If an unrevealed adjacent room exists, reveal its encounter.

effects.prose: Move horizontally or vertically between connected spaces; terrain may modify movement.
Reveal and resolve the searchable contents of the current location.
Interact with a valid object, device, terminal, clue, corpse, door, or machinery.
Help another crew member according to the selected assist effect.

assumptions: Scenario 01 prototype Reload restores 2 shared Ammo, capped by the Ammunition resource maximum.

effects.prose: Resolve one allowed temporary recovery effect; full healing generally requires a Medic or Ship Phase.
Reveal an adjacent room without entering it; do not resolve its encounter until entered.

play-card.name: Play card
assumptions: Scenario 01 prototype ordinary tactic/skill cards consume one action when played.

effects.prose: Reveal and enter an unexplored connection according to scenario topology.
Resolve the scenario extraction outcome at a valid extraction location.

steps.prose: Resolve temporary effects and status conditions.
Resolve enemy corpses, spider feeding, and environmental effects.
Resolve noise, threat, and scenario objectives.
Upgrade and reorganize at the ship.
Place Cave Mouth as the first materialized node.
Constrain Ancient Relay to the bottom three rooms.
During exploration, reveal a room, assign its stable node ID, and materialize its connecting edge.

priorities.fallback_prose: Move toward the corpse and feed if possible.

condition.prose: An injured crew target is reachable.

priorities.fallback_prose: Pursue and attack; do not retreat.
